headline: President signs fuel law. Leśkiewicz with two demands for Tusk's team | Niezalezna.pl
summary: Poland's president has signed a fuel law, noting Poles pay more than eight zloty for petrol and over nine zloty for diesel daily. He has made two demands of the government team.
why: Fuel taxes and price rules in Poland affect consumer costs, transport firms and the country's inflation outlook.
